This page provides supplementary material for EC7210 Macroeconomics, a
first-semester course in the Master's Program in Economics at Stockholm
University.

Stockholm University [course information](https://www.su.se/english/education/course-catalogue/ec/ec7210).

Lecture notes and slides are available on the [course page in Canvas](https://canvas.su.se/courses/13560).

## Lecture Notes 2: The Ramsey model

The scripts compute the transition from a given initial capital stock to
the steady state with constant productivity and population. They also
plot the transition path in the phase diagram.

- [MATLAB version (RamseyModel.m)](RamseyModel.m){download=""}
- [Python version (RamseyModel.py)](RamseyModel.py){download=""}

## Lecture Notes 4: The RBC model

The impulse-response scripts compute the responses illustrated in
Figures 1 and 2 of Lecture Notes 4. To compare the two calibrations,
run the script with different values of the labor-supply parameter
$\gamma$. The simulation scripts plot a short sample from the simulated
economy and compute the model moments reported in Table 1.

| Material | MATLAB | Python |
|:---------|:-------|:-------|
| Impulse responses | [rbc_ir.m](rbc_ir.m){download=""} | [rbc_ir.py](rbc_ir.py){download=""} |
| Simulation | [rbc_with_simulation.m](rbc_with_simulation.m){download=""} | [rbc_with_simulation.py](rbc_with_simulation.py){download=""} |

## Macroeconomic data

- **International organizations:**
  [OECD Data Explorer](https://data-explorer.oecd.org/),
  [IMF World Economic Outlook](https://www.imf.org/en/Publications/SPROLLs/world-economic-outlook-databases),
  [World Bank](https://data.worldbank.org/) and
  [BIS](https://data.bis.org/)
- **Statistical agencies:**
  [Statistics Sweden](https://www.statistikdatabasen.scb.se/pxweb/en/ssd/),
  [Eurostat](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/data/database) and
  [Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/data/)
- **Central banks:**
  [Riksbank](https://www.riksbank.se/en-gb/statistics/),
  [ECB](https://data.ecb.europa.eu/data/datasets) and
  [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/)
- **Growth and productivity:**
  [Penn World Table](https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/productivity/pwt/),
  [Maddison Project Database](https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/historicaldevelopment/maddison/releases/maddison-project-database-2023) and
  [AMECO](https://economy-finance.ec.europa.eu/economic-research-and-databases/economic-databases/ameco-database_en)
